catalogs.completeness_basis: Undergraduate Programs of Study: Majors and Minors page in the 2026-2027 Academic Catalog. It has 96 'Major' entries; collapsing the tracks and concentrations (e.g. Asian Studies B.A. with 6 concentrations, Classics B.A. with 3 tracks) gives 75 major+award programs. Separate awards are counted separately (e.g. Music B.A./B.Mus., Studio Art B.A./B.F.A.). Excluded: minors, D.D.S. and Pharm.D. The 74 verified records cover 67 of the 75. The earlier figure of 96 counted the tracks and concentrations.
